title: Add executable Japanese adopter lifecycle evidence
rawUserRequest: Japanese capability is mandatory because most adopter engineers use Japanese. Correct every issue found by the comprehensive Japanese assessment before documentation alignment or release, using a separate complete Work Item lifecycle for each issue.

declaredIntent.summary: Prove with an executable isolated adopter fixture that a Japanese operator can traverse installation, calibration pause/resume, rollback recovery, and evidence-preserving removal boundaries.

outOfScope: Changing installer, calibration, rollback, uninstall, detached-removal, or lifecycle production behavior.
Claiming that fixture execution proves general Japanese fluency, provider operations, production readiness, enterprise compliance, or an adopter's real platform evidence.
Adding the actionable Japanese uninstall documentation required by JA-DOC-001.
Starting documentation alignment, deprecated-assets cleanup, or release.
Combining JA-DOC-001 into this Work Item.

sources.reason: JA-LIFECYCLE-001 records the absence of executable Japanese adopter lifecycle evidence.
The authoritative Japanese beginner path defines prompt-first installation, calibration, recovery, and lifecycle boundaries.
Existing isolated adopter installation evidence establishes real Git and installer fixture patterns.
Existing executable Japanese calibration tests establish localized pause and resume behavior.
Existing rollback tests establish fail-closed recovery and project-owned content preservation.
Existing uninstall tests establish confirmation gating and evidence-preserving removal planning.
Existing detached executor tests establish confirmed runtime removal while preserving project and evidence files.
WI-16 orders JA-LIFECYCLE-001 after PR output and before JA-DOC-001.

riskAssessment.reason: A file-existence-only fixture could clear the release gate without executing the Japanese operator boundary or without preserving fail-closed recovery/removal behavior.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized correction of every Japanese assessment finding and continuous execution.

preReviewWarnings: Require an actual isolated adopter installation, not a synthetic file-presence assertion.
Verify Japanese presentation without translating or inventing evidence-bearing machine values.
Verify unconfirmed, drifted, or unknown-ownership recovery/removal paths remain write-free.
Keep JA-DOC-001 blocking until its separate actionable documentation Work Item completes.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A dedicated executable test creates an isolated Japanese-named adopter Git repository and runs the real Installation Wizard with Japanese locale through confirmed New Adoption.

The installed fixture proves Japanese Wizard chrome, a dedicated adoption branch, release/source binding in the generated Contract, and installed Japanese operator documentation without inferring provider or platform evidence.
The same fixture executes the installed Calibration Session Make entrypoint through pause and resume, preserving language ja, Japanese evidence values, and canonical machine stage identifiers.

Rollback recovery remains proposal-first and confirmation-gated; an unconfirmed or drifted path performs zero writes, while confirmed recovery restores only owned runtime content and preserves project configuration.
Removal remains proposal-first and evidence-preserving; unknown ownership blocks with zero writes, and confirmed detached removal preserves project-owned files and the evidence receipt.
The Japanese assessor requires the dedicated fixture plus named installation, calibration, recovery, and removal assertions before JA-LIFECYCLE-001 can pass.
A mutation regression proves deleting any required executable lifecycle assertion keeps JA-LIFECYCLE-001 blocking.
The machine JSON and derived Markdown assessment are regenerated; JA-LIFECYCLE-001 passes while JA-DOC-001 remains blocking.
The comprehensive plan records bounded executable evidence, non-claims, remaining serial queue, and any issue found.
Full local finish/archive, one PR, Hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and synchronized clean main complete before JA-DOC-001 begins.
guidelines: Exercise installed production entrypoints and existing lifecycle authorities; do not duplicate their implementation in the fixture.
Keep Japanese localization limited to operator chrome and preserve evidence-bearing values and identifiers.
Require fail-closed zero-write behavior before confirmation and when ownership or drift is unknown.
Clear only JA-LIFECYCLE-001; retain JA-DOC-001 and all general-fluency and external-evidence limitations.
Keep the fixture isolated, deterministic, network-free, and bounded to a temporary adopter repository.

intent.problem: The Japanese capability gate currently sees no executable fixture that joins the localized operator path to the real adopter lifecycle. Separate unit tests cover Japanese Wizard text and English lifecycle authorities, but their coexistence cannot prove a Japanese adopter can install, pause/resume calibration, recover, and remove runtime under the same fail-closed boundaries.
constraints: Use the real installer and existing calibration, rollback, uninstall-proposal, and detached-removal authorities.
Do not change production behavior merely to satisfy the fixture.
Do not convert English fixture evidence into a Japanese usability claim.
Keep external provider actions, real platform quality, and general language fluency explicitly unproved.
Finish this Work Item lifecycle before starting the separate JA-DOC-001 correction.
intent.rationale: A bounded cross-authority test in an isolated Japanese-named adopter repository provides stronger evidence than keyword or file-existence checks while preserving each production component as the single source of behavior.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Japanese operator confirms New Adoption in an isolated clean Git repository.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The real installer succeeds on a dedicated adoption branch, emits Japanese operator chrome, records release/source identity, and installs Japanese guidance.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the Japanese lifecycle fixture against the real Installation Wizard and Installer.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The installed adopter starts Japanese calibration, pauses, and resumes.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Japanese prompts and state are visible while canonical stage identifiers and persisted evidence remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise CalibrationWizard with ja-JP over the installed fixture and inspect persisted session facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Recovery is requested without confirmation or against drifted facts, then with valid confirmation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Unconfirmed and drifted recovery write nothing; confirmed recovery restores owned runtime content and preserves project configuration.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise rollback snapshot, proposal, and executor boundaries in the Japanese adopter fixture.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Removal is requested with unknown ownership, then from a detached confirmed session.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Unknown ownership blocks with zero writes; confirmed detached removal removes only runtime and preserves project-owned content plus evidence receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise uninstall proposal and detached executor using installed ownership-shaped facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The fixture file remains but one required lifecycle assertion is deleted.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Japanese assessment returns JA-LIFECYCLE-001 as blocking.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add assessor mutation tests for required named executable coverage.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.
